tagline: Add Apple, Microsoft, LinkedIn, Amazon and GitHub sign-in to Softaware Social Login — same buttons, same settings, same account rules.
key_features: Microsoft personal, work and school accounts
Settings in the same Social Login section

benefits.title: The accounts your customers use
benefits.text: Apple for iPhone users, Microsoft and LinkedIn for business buyers, Amazon for shoppers, GitHub for developers.

benefits.title: Strict where it matters
benefits.text: Apple's client secret is signed per request, ID tokens are checked against each provider's keys, and unverified emails are never trusted.

benefits.title: Nothing new to learn
benefits.text: The five providers join the existing buttons, placements, Connected Accounts page and admin grid of Social Login.

showcase.label: Sign-in page
showcase.title: Eight providers in one row
showcase.text: Apple, Microsoft, LinkedIn, Amazon and GitHub appear next to Google, Facebook and X, in the order you choose.

showcase.label: Hyvä
showcase.title: Native Hyvä buttons
showcase.text: Each provider brings its own icon for the Luma and Hyvä templates of Social Login.

showcase.label: Mobile
showcase.title: Full-width rows on phones
showcase.text: Buttons stack on small screens, where Sign in with Apple is often the quickest way in.

showcase.label: Apple settings
showcase.title: Sign in with Apple, set up in minutes
showcase.text: Paste the Services ID, Team ID, Key ID and the .p8 key. The client secret is created and signed for every request.

showcase.label: Microsoft settings
showcase.title: Personal and organisation accounts
showcase.text: The common tenant by default, or limit sign-in to consumers, organisations or your own tenant.
